widgets_values: The image is a square close-up photograph of a garment detail, featuring a matte dusty rose jacket panel and a dark charcoal lower section. In the upper-left corner, a small section of dark grey ribbed knit fabric is visible, tucked beneath the jacket's hem. The upper-right portion of the frame is occupied by the smooth, slightly wrinkled surface of the dusty rose jacket, which appears to be made of a synthetic, water-resistant material. Running vertically through the center-left of the frame is a zipper track with fine, tightly interlocked teeth in a matching dusty rose tone. At the bottom of the zipper track, in the center of the frame, a zipper pull hangs down. The zipper pull is a matte, dusty rose plastic slider with a rounded, elongated shape and a small loop at the top where it attaches to the zipper mechanism. The zipper pull is positioned directly in front of the dark charcoal fabric that fills the lower half of the image. The dark charcoal fabric appears to be a smooth, matte material, possibly a skirt or trousers, with subtle vertical folds and a soft texture. The lighting is soft and diffused, coming from the upper left, casting gentle shadows on the right side of the zipper pull and creating subtle highlights on the wrinkles of the dusty rose jacket. The overall composition is a tight, detailed crop that emphasizes the texture and color contrast between the dusty rose jacket and the dark charcoal lower garment, with a clean, minimalist aesthetic.
